u0: This is the shop's resting stage, with no siren, boil, in-progress order, prepared food, or fallen food currently waiting for action. Keep watching for the next client, siren, pot boil, or slip and respond when it occurs. There is no separate terminal goal; continue running the shop through the episode.
u1: The siren is ringing and must be turned off at the switch. Once you face the switch and toggle it, this obligation is cleared. Keep an eye out for other events that may need attention while you deal with the siren.
u10: Prepared food is ready and the pot is boiling over. Turn the stove down; if the prepared food is in your hands, set it down beside the stove first and pick it up again afterward. The order still needs to be served to the waiting client.
u11: Prepared food is ready, the siren is ringing, and the pot is boiling over. Silence the siren, and turn the stove down; if the prepared food is in your hands, set it down beside the stove, work the stove, and pick it up again. The prepared food still needs to be served to the waiting client.
u12: Food has just slipped from your hands. You must be holding it again on the very next step, which means picking it up immediately. Missing that step breaks a required rule and fails the run.
u13: Food has just slipped while the siren is ringing. The very next step must be spent recovering the food; missing that deadline fails the run. After recovering it, turn the siren off at the switch.
u14: Food has just slipped while the pot is boiling over. Recover the food on the very next step before anything else. Afterward, turn the stove down; if you are then carrying the food, set it down beside the stove, turn the stove down, and pick it up again.
u15: Food has just slipped, the siren is ringing, and the pot is boiling over. Recover the food on the very next step; missing that deadline fails the run. Then silence the siren and turn the stove down, setting down any carried food while you work the stove and picking it up afterward.
u16: Food has just slipped and a client's order has been taken. Pick the food up on the very next step. After recovering it, continue the order by preparing food at the stove and serving the waiting client.
u17: Food has just slipped, a client's order is in progress, and the siren is ringing. Recovering the food on the very next step comes first. After that, silence the siren and complete the order by preparing the food and serving the client.
u18: Food has just slipped, a client's order has been taken, and the pot is boiling over. Recover the food on the very next step. Then turn the stove down and finish the order, setting down and retrieving carried food as needed while you prepare and serve it.
u19: Food has just slipped, a client's order has been taken, the siren is ringing, and the pot is boiling over. The very next step must be used to recover the food. Afterward, silence the siren, turn the stove down while putting down and retrieving carried food as needed, and complete the order by preparing and serving it.
u2: The pot is boiling over and must be turned down. The stove can only be operated with empty hands, so if you are carrying food, set it down beside the stove, turn the stove down, and pick the food up again. That clears the boil unless it starts again later.
u20: The prepared portion has slipped out of your hands. It must be recovered on the very next step and then served to the client whose order is already taken and who is still waiting. Until that delivery is made, the prepared dish remains an outstanding obligation.
u21: The prepared portion has slipped and the siren is ringing. Recovering the food on the next step is the immediate requirement; once it is back in hand, the siren still needs to be switched off and the prepared dish served to the waiting client. Both of those later obligations remain until completed.
u22: The prepared portion has slipped and the pot is boiling over. The food must be recovered immediately; then the pot must be turned down, setting the carried dish down beside the stove first and picking it up again afterward. The prepared dish still also has to be served to the waiting client.
u23: The prepared portion has slipped, the siren is ringing, and the pot is boiling over. Recover the food on the next step; afterward, switch the siren off and turn the stove down, putting the carried dish down by the stove before using the stove and picking it up again. The prepared dish also remains to be served to the waiting client.
u24: A client has arrived and is waiting, but the order has not yet been taken. Take the order, obtain a portion of raw food if you are not already carrying one, prepare it at the stove, and serve it. The order remains incomplete until the food is handed over.
u25: A client is waiting for an order to be taken, and the siren is ringing. The order must be taken and the siren switched off; afterward the client's food must still be obtained, prepared, and served. The siren will keep ringing until it is dealt with.
u26: A client has arrived without an order being taken, and the pot is boiling over. Take the order and turn the stove down, setting down any carried food first and picking it up again afterward. The ordered food will still need to be obtained, prepared, and served.
u27: A client is waiting for an order, the siren is ringing, and the pot is boiling over. Take the order, switch the siren off, and turn the stove down, putting down any carried food before using the stove and picking it up afterward. The client's food must then be obtained, prepared, and served.
u28: An arrived client still needs an order taken, while a prepared portion is already waiting to be served. Take the pending order and deliver the prepared dish; the new order will also require a fresh preparation and serving after it is taken.
u29: A client still needs an order taken, prepared food is waiting to be served, and the siren is ringing. Switch the siren off, take the pending order, and deliver the prepared dish; the newly taken order will still need its own food prepared and served.
u3: Both the siren and the pot need attention: silence the siren and turn down the boiling stove. If you are carrying food when you go to the stove, set it down first and retrieve it afterward. These two duties can be handled in either order.
u30: A client's order is still to be taken, prepared food is waiting to be served, and the pot is boiling over. Turn the stove down, setting down any carried food first, take the order, and deliver the prepared dish; the new order then needs its own food prepared and served.
u31: A client's order is still to be taken, prepared food is waiting to be served, the siren is ringing, and the pot is boiling over. Switch the siren off, turn the stove down after setting down any carried food, take the pending order, and serve the prepared dish. The newly taken order will also require fresh preparation and serving.
u32: A client has arrived and food has slipped from your hands. Pick the food up on the very next step; after that, take the client's order, complete the food preparation as needed, and serve it. The arrival obligation is not complete until the order is taken and the food handed over.
u33: A client is waiting for an order, the siren is ringing, and food has slipped from your hands. The food must be picked up on the very next step; then switch the siren off, take the order, and prepare and serve the food.
u34: A client's order is pending, food has slipped, and the pot is boiling over. Recover the food on the next step; then turn the stove down after setting down any carried food, and take the order and prepare and serve its food.
u35: A client's order is pending, food has slipped, the siren is ringing, and the pot is boiling over. Pick the food up immediately; then switch the siren off, turn the stove down after setting down any carried food, and take and fulfill the client's order.
u36: A prepared portion has slipped from your hands, and a client arrival still needs an order taken. Recover the prepared food on the next step and serve it; also take the pending order and prepare and serve fresh food for it.
u37: A prepared portion has slipped, a client's order still needs taking, and the siren is ringing. Recover the food immediately; afterward switch the siren off, serve the prepared dish, and take the pending order and prepare and serve its food.
u38: A prepared portion has slipped, a client's order still needs taking, and the pot is boiling over. Recover the food on the next step; then turn the stove down after setting down any carried food, serve the prepared dish, and take and fulfill the pending order.
u39: A prepared portion has slipped, a client's order still needs taking, the siren is ringing, and the pot is boiling over. Recover the food immediately; then switch the siren off, turn the stove down after setting down any carried food, serve the prepared dish, and take and complete the pending order.
u4: A client's order has been taken, so the order is now in progress. You still need to have raw food ready, prepare it at the stove for that waiting client, and then serve the prepared food. The order is not finished until the serving step.
u40: An order has already been taken, and a client has since arrived. The earlier order still needs food prepared and then served, while the newly arrived client's order still has to be taken and then carried through preparation and service.
u41: An order has already been taken, a client has arrived since, and the siren is ringing. Prepare and serve the earlier order, take the newly arrived client's order and complete it, and switch the siren off; leaving it ringing while a client waits is costly.
u42: An order has already been taken, a client has arrived since, and the pot is boiling over. Prepare and serve the earlier order, take and complete the new client's order, and turn the stove down; if food is being carried, set it beside the stove first and pick it up again afterward.
u43: An order has already been taken, a client has arrived since, the pot is boiling over, and the siren is ringing. Prepare and serve the earlier order, take and complete the new client's order, silence the siren, and turn the stove down, setting aside any carried food before reaching the stove and retrieving it afterward.
u44: On the step a client arrived, the food being carried slipped, so it must be picked up on the very next move or the episode fails. An order had been taken earlier and still needs preparing and serving, and the newly arrived client's order still needs to be taken.
u45: On the step a client arrived, the food being carried slipped while the siren was ringing. Pick it up on the very next move, then prepare and serve the earlier order, take and complete the new client's order, and switch the siren off.
u46: On the step a client arrived, the food being carried slipped while the pot was boiling over. Pick it up on the very next move, then prepare and serve the earlier order, take and complete the new client's order, and turn the stove down; empty your hands beside the stove first and pick the food up again afterward.
u47: On the step a client arrived, the food being carried slipped while both the pot was boiling and the siren was ringing. Pick it up on the very next move, then prepare and serve the earlier order, take and complete the new client's order, silence the siren, and turn the stove down, setting the food beside the stove and retrieving it afterward.
u48: Food has already been prepared, and an order has been taken since then. The prepared portion still needs to be served, and the later order still needs food prepared and then served.
u49: Food has already been prepared, an order has been taken since then, and the siren is ringing. Serve the prepared portion, prepare and serve the later order, and switch the siren off without leaving a waiting client under a long ring.
u5: A client's order has been taken and the siren is ringing. Silence the siren, and complete the order by preparing food at the stove and serving it to the waiting client. The two duties are independent; neither is complete until its own action is done.
u50: Food has already been prepared, an order has been taken since then, and the pot is boiling over. Serve the prepared portion, prepare and serve the later order, and turn the stove down; if food is being carried, put it beside the stove first and pick it up again afterward.
u51: Food has already been prepared, an order has been taken since, the siren is ringing, and the pot is boiling over. Serve the prepared portion, prepare and serve the later order, silence the siren, and turn the stove down, setting aside any carried food before using the stove and retrieving it afterward.
u52: Food was prepared earlier, and on the same step that an order was taken the carried food slipped. Recover the dropped food on the very next move or fail; afterward, the prepared portion still needs serving, and the newly taken order still needs food prepared and served.
u53: Food was prepared earlier, and on the same step that an order was taken the carried food slipped while the siren was ringing. Pick the dropped food up on the very next move, then serve the prepared portion, prepare and serve the new order, and switch the siren off.
u54: Food was prepared earlier, and on the same step that an order was taken the carried food slipped while the pot was boiling over. Pick it up on the very next move, then serve the prepared portion, prepare and serve the new order, and turn the stove down, setting the recovered food beside the stove first and picking it up again afterward.
u55: Food was prepared earlier, and on the same step that an order was taken the carried food slipped while both the pot was boiling and the siren was ringing. Pick it up on the very next move, then serve the prepared portion, prepare and serve the new order, silence the siren, and turn the stove down, setting the recovered food beside the stove and retrieving it afterward.
u56: The food slipped and was not picked up on the immediately following step. That breaks the mandatory next-move recovery rule permanently, so the episode has failed and no later action can make it succeed.
u57: Food has been prepared, an order was taken after that, and a further client has arrived. The prepared portion still needs serving, the taken order still needs food prepared and served, and the newest client's order still needs to be taken and then completed.
u58: Food has been prepared, an order was taken after that, a further client has arrived, and the siren is ringing. Serve the prepared portion, prepare and serve the taken order, take and complete the newest client's order, and switch the siren off.
u59: Food has been prepared, an order was taken after that, a further client has arrived, and the pot is boiling over. Serve the prepared portion, prepare and serve the taken order, take and complete the newest client's order, and turn the stove down, setting aside any carried food and retrieving it afterward.
u6: A client's order has been taken and the pot is boiling over. Turn the stove down and also prepare and serve the ordered food. If you are carrying food when you work on the stove, set it down first and pick it up again afterward.
u60: Several jobs are open at once: take the order for the client who has arrived, prepare food for an order already taken, and serve food that has already been prepared. The siren is ringing and the pot is boiling, so the siren switch must be toggled and the stove turned down; if the agent is carrying food when dealing with the pot, it must set the food down near the stove first and pick it up again. No dropped-food pickup is currently forced, though later events can add new demands.
u61: The food has just slipped from the agent's hands, so it must be picked up on the very next step or the task fails. Three order-related jobs are also open: take the order for the client who has arrived, prepare food for an order already taken, and serve food that has already been prepared. Neither the siren nor the pot is currently an outstanding problem, though future rings or boils may still occur.
u62: The food has just slipped and must be picked up on the very next step, or the task fails. The siren is ringing and still needs to be silenced; the pot is not currently boiling over. Three order-related jobs are also open: take the order for the client who has arrived, prepare food for an order already taken, and serve food that has already been prepared.
u63: The food has just slipped, so the agent must pick it up on the very next step to avoid failure. The pot is boiling over and needs the stove turned down; if the agent is holding food, it must set it down near the stove before turning the stove down and then pick it up again. The siren is not currently ringing. Three order-related jobs are also open: take the order for the client who has arrived, prepare food for an order already taken, and serve food that has already been prepared.
u64: The food has just slipped and must be picked up on the very next step, or the task fails. The siren is ringing and the pot is boiling, so the siren switch must be toggled and the stove turned down; handling the pot may require putting down any carried food near the stove first and picking it up again. Three order-related jobs are also open: take the order for the client who has arrived, prepare food for an order already taken, and serve food that has already been prepared.
u7: A client's order is in progress, the siren is ringing, and the pot is boiling over. Silence the siren, turn the stove down, and finish the order by preparing and serving its food. When using the stove with food in hand, put the food down first and retrieve it afterward.
u8: Prepared food is ready for a client whose order has already been taken. The remaining step is to get it into your hands if necessary and serve it to that waiting client. If it slips before the serving, recovering it on the very next step becomes the immediate priority.
u9: Prepared food is ready to serve, and the siren is ringing. Silence the siren and serve the waiting client; get the food back in hand first if it was set down. If it slips before it is served, pick it up on the very next step.
